requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5400-5929--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2105-4359-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4359-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4359-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4772-5254-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4772-5254-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

3967-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-5254-8122.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

522-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

339-677-728-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

333-3899-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-3899-7424.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-7297-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3755-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2438-3240-6462-7422.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-6297-6972.description:
Activate King Darien XLVIII by sacrificing it.
When King Darien XLVIII dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the King Darien XLVIII ability.
Repeat.

650-2921-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2372-2821-7163.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Minamo can produce at least {R}{G}{W}{U} after being tapped twice.
2372-2821-7163.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Wilderness Reclamation triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding an amount of mana.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Wilderness Reclamation's trigger twice.
Resolve the first copy of Wilderness Reclamation's trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control, including Minamo, by tapping them, adding {U} and an additional amount of mana.
Resolve the second copy of Wilderness Reclamation's trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Holding priority, activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Repeat from step 2.
2372-2821-7163.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you are able to add relevant mana before activating Mister Fantastic's ability for the first time. If Minamo is untapped, you may tap it for blue mana to remove the need for blue mana. If you make excess {U}, you can forego tapping Minamo for mana and instead untap other legendary permanents at will.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
206-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

773-1409-4365.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

328-413-2173-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-413-2173-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

997-2173-5220-6537.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1115-1270-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-5756-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Havi.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing The Jolly Balloon Man, adding {R}.
Resolve the Jolly Balloon Man ability, creating a token copy of Havi that is a 1/1 Balloon.
Put the Havi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Havi token dies, it triggers, returning The Jolly Balloon Man from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

440-567-1339-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-567-1339-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

751-2498-3091.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Dreams triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

952-1103-1368-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
952-1103-1368-5231.description:
Cast Flamekin Harbinger from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Flamekin Harbinger enters the battlefield, choose not to search your library.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Flamekin Harbinger, adding {R}.
Flamekin Harbinger dies, triggering Titania's second ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1724-2773.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Sekki enters, Warstorm Surge triggers, targeting Sekki. Sekki prevents the 8 damage that would be dealt to it and instead removes eight +1/+1 counters from Sekki and creates eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Sekki dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Spirits enter, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times, dealing a total of 8 damage divided among any number of targets.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing the eight Spirit tokens, returning Sekki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

225-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3478-4222.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
